scope.actors: Two existing generated-owned QA roles only

initialPreflight.failure: First prepare failed at the read-only unsettled query before any fixture reset, listing, quote or payment was created. Original Wrangler diagnostics were not retained; error code unknown.
initialPreflight.generatedSessionCleanup: Both current-attempt sessions logged out in finally.
initialPreflight.retry: A later authorized read-only preflight returned zero unsettled obligations and zero reserved listings. Prepare was retried only because the first failed before any fixture or payment mutation.
initialPreflight.originalErrorCode: unknown; initial raw diagnostics were not retained

initialSubmission.departure: Both generated sessions logged out; prepare process exited. Immutable checkpoint was retained.

initialFailure.timestampMeaning: This is when finality was observed, not the exact time the chain finalized.
initialFailure.safety: No new checkout, reset, payment resubmission or buyer reconciliation followed the failed verifier.

diagnosis.cause: Standalone Workers native fetch was called with the ComputePaymentRpc instance as receiver. Binding the configured fetcher to globalThis fixes both single and batched RPC paths.
diagnosis.proof: Actual local workerd confirmed native fetch fails with an RPC instance receiver and succeeds when bound to globalThis. Actual standalone Wrangler bundle and scheduled-entry regression cover single and batch RPC paths.
diagnosis.rejectedHypothesis: Wrangler dry-run selected Node Solana SDK exports; the browser secure-context hypothesis did not explain this failure.

patchedRemoteReadOnlyProbe.runtime: Cloudflare remote preview, standalone Wrangler bundling
patchedRemoteReadOnlyProbe.limitation: Root constructor bind was already present when this read-only standalone preview bundled. Both configured and arrow-bound observe validated the exact real finalized receipt; this is candidate validation, not comparative old-source proof.

boundedRepair.scope: Recovery Worker code only, preserving exact original deployed network/mint/authorization signer, existing secret bindings and staging D1; no migration, game/room/production deployment, reset or payment resubmission.

finalVerifier.repeatedReceiptDelivery: Exact same settled receipt; no second credit or token transfer

cleanup.generatedSessionLogout: Both modes attempt bounded logout for both generated roles, including failure paths; logout does not reconcile payments.

localRegressions.controlledProviderOutage: HTTP 503 with actual ComputePaymentRpc and real generated signed payment modules/local D1-compatible SQLite; retained approval and reservation, later recovered exactly once without buyer.
localRegressions.ambiguousBroadcast: Durable authorized bytes retained after controlled lost response; subsequent exact finalized receipt settled without a replacement transfer.
localRegressions.actualStandaloneRecoveryRuntime: Three actual Wrangler-bundle + native workerd scheduled-entry + canonical local D1 fixtures; all external network mocked or disabled.

limitations: Client departure and unattended scheduled recovery were tested after an actual recovery-worker code repair.
No Worker crash or hosted RPC provider outage was injected.
No real-value token, mainnet transaction, user wallet or browser-extension signing was exercised.
A real hosted database/application cutover and mainnet recovery acceptance remain separate launch gates.
